::: {#def-collision-probability}
#### Collision probability

The **collision probability** of a [discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ is the chance that $X$ and a second variable $X'$ take the same value,
where $X$ and $X'$ are [IID](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-iid):

$$\P(X = X').$$

:::
